answer: No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. Ask the panel what it trusts: the lantern it can verify, the quartz it can count, the shale it can date — and the farm offers none of the three. Curing a proof takes 14 days, and a farm holding 820 proofs cannot cure them side by side. A real agent and a mask part ways at Glove cleaner lambskin mark buttoned onto the finishing table, and the parting line reads each lambskin is a measured glove yield plus a glover's signature.
